declaration.preface: At Plastipak packaging Inc (Group), we are committed to fostering a sustainable future by integrating environmentally responsible practices across all aspects of our operations. Our green environmental policy focuses on minimizing waste, reducing carbon emissions, and promoting circular economy initiatives through advanced recycling technologies like bottle-to-bottle recycling. With a dedication to energy-efficient production and the use of recycled materials, we aim to reduce environmental impact while supporting our customers' sustainability goals. This policy underscores our commitment to innovation, continuous improvement, and collaboration with stakeholders to safeguard the environment and contribute to a more sustainable future.
declaration.declaration:
Promote Circular Economy: Encourage bottle-to-bottle recycling and increase the use of post-consumer recycled resin (rPET) to reduce waste and dependence on virgin materials.

Minimize Carbon Footprint: Implement energy-efficient processes and reduce greenhouse gas emissions across manufacturing and distribution activities.

Sustainable Packaging Solutions: Design innovative packaging that is recyclable, reduces environmental impact, and enhances product sustainability for customers.

Conserve Natural Resources: Optimize water and energy consumption throughout operations to promote environmental stewardship.

Waste Reduction and Management: Reduce operational waste and enhance recycling initiatives to minimize landfill contributions.

Compliance with Environmental Regulations: Adhere to global environmental standards and continuously improve processes to meet evolving regulatory requirements.

Foster a Green Supply Chain: Collaborate with suppliers and stakeholders to integrate sustainability practices throughout the value chain.

Employee Engagement and Awareness: Promote sustainability awareness among employees through education, training, and involvement in environmental initiatives.

Continuous Improvement: Set measurable environmental targets and monitor progress to ensure ongoing improvement in sustainability performance.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all Plastipak employees, contractors, third-party partners, and internal - external stakeholders, including customers directly or indirectly associated with Plastipak. It extends across all offices, headquarters, facilities, and operating sites where Plastipak provides packaging solutions, recycled materials, and transportation services, ensuring sustainable practices are embedded throughout the organization’s global operations.

focusAreas: Air Quality Management and Pollution Reduction
Minimizing Environmental Impact from Product Use

Energy Usage and Emission Control: Having implemented 1,800 solar panels at our manufacturing site in Toledo, Spain, we aim to enhance operational efficiency by integrating renewable energy solutions across our other manufacturing facilities and processes as well.
Our focus is on strategically transitioning to low-carbon technologies to effectively cut emissions and mitigate adverse climate impact across our operations.
We have completed LED lighting retrofits at a majority of sites and aim to finalize installations across all locations to further reduce energy consumption and GHG emissions.
Our focus is on updating equipment with newer, energy-efficient options to optimize energy consumption and minimize environmental impact across all operational activities.

We strive to consistently monitor energy consumption levels through a real-time energy management system, setting measurable annual benchmarks to drive continuous improvement initiatives and achieve optimized outcomes.

We aim to significantly modernize our vehicle fleet and forklifts to enhance operational efficiency and reduce fuel consumption across our diverse transportation and logistics operations wherever feasible.
We regularly assess all our facilities using a real-time energy management system to identify additional opportunities for reducing our energy footprint.
Water Conservation and Resource Manageme: We strive to significantly improve resource management by systematically upgrading our equipment to optimize water usage across all manufacturing facilities and processes whenever feasible.

We aim to maintain and improve our closed-loop systems across all manufacturing sites to reduce reliance on municipal and freshwater, ensuring prompt repairs of any leaks while continuously monitoring pollutant levels to enhance water conservation.

We are committed to improving water management by conducting thorough water risk analyses at all our sites, which identify critical issues related to water stress, depletion, flood, and drought risks. Consequently, each site is actively formulating targeted water-reduction and mitigation strategies to address these challenges.
We prioritize sustainable water stewardship through efficient usage and extensive recycling within our essential production processes and operations.
We seek to proactively implement rainwater harvesting and ground water collection system  across all our operational facilities and locations.
Collaboration with key stakeholders ensures responsible water use throughout our entire value chain processes and sustainability efforts.
Ecosystem Preservation and Biodiversity: We are deeply committed to protecting local ecosystems by integrating biodiversity-friendly practices in all our comprehensive operations and initiatives.
Our efforts include actively supporting reforestation programs and creating green spaces near our various operational sites and facilities.
We endeavor to prevent habitat disruption and rigorously engage in biodiversity impact assessments to thoroughly measure outcomes and impacts.
Partnerships with conservation organizations drive our initiatives for preserving local flora and fauna in every operational area and region.
Air Quality Management and Pollution Red: We aim to significantly modernize our vehicle fleet and forklifts to enhance operational efficiency and reduce air pollution emissions and greenhouse gas impacts across our diverse transportation and logistics operations wherever feasible.
We focus on significantly minimizing airborne pollutants (VOC, PM, etc)  by adopting advanced filtration and effective air quality control systems and technologies.
Emission reduction targets include systematically phasing out outdated equipment contributing to poor air quality levels and standards.
Engaging local communities, we actively advocate for cleaner air practices and public awareness initiatives for everyone in our network.
Resource Efficiency and Waste Management: We commit to significantly reducing material use by promoting lightweight packaging designs and optimizing sustainable designs across all products.

We aim to establish comprehensive waste management practices across all Plastipak manufacturing sites, ensuring effective waste segregation, reduction, and recycling to minimize our environmental footprint and promote sustainability in our operations.
We aim to ensure that all product designs created by our Creative Package Studio adhere to independently developed design-for-recyclability criteria to enhance the recyclability of our packaging.
We aim to actively collaborate with our customers to identify and eliminate product designs or features that hinder effective recycling, reinforcing our commitment to circular economy principles.

We strive to improve our sustainability efforts by actively incorporating bio-based and  recycled materials into our manufacturing processes and product designs wherever feasible, reducing waste and conserving natural resources.
Minimizing Environmental Impact from Pro: We strive to design and manufacture our products with a sustainability mindset, prioritizing the reduction of environmental impacts while maximizing resource efficiency throughout our entire value chain.
We seek to minimize environmental harm by developing innovative and eco-friendly product formulations for our customers and clients.
We aim to conduct a life cycle assessment of all our products using a peer-reviewed, ISO 14040-44-compliant, and EU Product Environmental Footprint (PEF)-approved platform.

We are dedicated to enhancing sustainability through right-weighting, which optimizes a package’s weight to minimize environmental impact while ensuring safe and effective management throughout the supply chain.

We are committed to advancing sustainability by implementing lightweighting techniques that reduce overall material consumption and minimize container carbon footprints and costs. We continuously invests in this technology, providing our customers with cutting-edge lightweight solutions for products, significantly aiding in the reduction of Scope 3 emissions.
We aim to actively collaborate with our customers to identify and eliminate product designs or features that hinder effective recycling, reinforcing our commitment to circular economy principles.
Product End-of-Life and Recycling Initia: We strive to engage actively with our customers to assess and redesign product features that impede effective recycling at the end of life, reinforcing our commitment to circular economy principles.
We are currently working toward RecyClass Post consumer resin (PCR) traceability certification for all our European recycling and packaging production sites.
We aim to actively support a circular economy through robust recycling and material recovery systems for all our products and packaging.
Our efforts include consistently increasing the recyclability of packaging solutions by improving product design features and materials.
Research into biodegradable and compostable materials forms a core part of our ongoing innovation strategy initiatives for future products.
Customer Safety and Well-Being: Our products are designed with a strong focus on safety, meeting the highest health standards and industry regulations across markets.
We aim to ensure that all raw materials used are free from harmful chemicals that could pose significant risks to health.
Regular audits and testing help maintain the highest quality and safety benchmarks for our products and services across all operations.
Customer education initiatives support the safe use and responsible disposal of our products across various applications and industries.
Encouraging Sustainable Consumption: We aim to support our customers in reducing their carbon footprint by offering alternative or innovative solutions, such as rPET containers, where the use of recycled materials lowers the overall carbon emissions of the package.
We promote awareness of sustainable packaging choices among consumers and partners for environmentally friendly practices and solutions.
Our marketing strategies focus on encouraging the adoption of eco-friendly products and sustainable solutions in the competitive market.
Transparency in product information allows customers to make informed choices that align with their sustainability goals and values.
Environmental Advocacy and Service Initi: We actively participate in important environmental policy dialogues and global sustainability forums like The Association of Plastic Recyclers (APR), European PET Bottle Platform (EPBP) , International Bottled Water Association (IBWA) etc. to drive meaningful change in communities.
Partnerships it with PETCORE's RecycleTheOne campaign enhance our advocacy efforts and community engagement initiatives for broader impact.
We aim to engage employees and stakeholders in meaningful environmental volunteering programs that promote positive change and awareness initiatives.
Our continuous environmental reporting ensures accountability and fosters public trust within our various communities and stakeholder networks.

policy.monitoring:
We will prepare annual environmental performance reports to monitor progress against key targets, including energy use, emissions, water conservation, and waste reduction.

These reports will be shared with stakeholders, including employees, customers, suppliers, and investors, to maintain transparency and accountability.

Regular internal audits will ensure compliance with environmental regulations, company policies, and operational goals.

Audit findings will be reviewed by senior management, with corrective actions implemented promptly to address any gaps.

We will engage stakeholders through surveys, consultations, and meetings to gather feedback on our environmental initiatives and identify areas for improvement.

Collaboration with partners will ensure continuous alignment with evolving sustainability trends and industry standards.

A dedicated platform will allow employees, customers, and third parties to report environmental concerns confidentially and without fear of retaliation.

All reports will be investigated promptly, with appropriate actions taken to address the concerns raised.

We will publish key environmental metrics, achievements, and challenges annually through sustainability reports or dedicated sections on our website.

This transparency will demonstrate our commitment to environmental stewardship and accountability to all stakeholders.

The governance of this policy ensures accountability across all levels, with the Board of Directors providing strategic oversight and setting environmental goals. Senior leadership integrates sustainability across operations and monitors performance, while the Environmental Compliance Officer ensures regulatory compliance and reports progress. Department heads implement practices within their functions, driving resource efficiency and waste reduction. Employees and contractors actively participate in environmental programs and report improvements. Suppliers and partners collaborate to meet sustainability targets, supporting circular economy initiatives. Regular audits, stakeholder engagement, and transparent reporting ensure continuous improvement and alignment with evolving standards.

We are committed to continuously enhancing our environmental performance by setting measurable targets, monitoring progress, and identifying opportunities for improvement. Regular internal audits, performance assessments, and stakeholder feedback help ensure our practices remain effective and aligned with emerging environmental standards. We also benchmark against industry best practices to drive innovation and strengthen our sustainability initiatives.

This policy is reviewed annually to adapt to evolving regulations, technological advancements, and environmental trends. Training programs and awareness campaigns foster a culture of sustainability among employees, empowering them to contribute to our environmental goals. Through collaboration with partners and suppliers, we aim to develop new solutions that enhance resource efficiency, reduce emissions, and promote a circular economy across our value chain.
policy.reviewMechanism: The Environmental Compliance Officer will conduct an annual review of this policy to assess its effectiveness and relevance. This process will include evaluating compliance with environmental regulations, analyzing performance metrics, and identifying areas for improvement. Recommendations will be documented and presented to management for consideration and implementation.
